title: How to Breakdance | Pogo Rock(Back Rock) | Jay Rawk(Style Elements/Floor Rockers)

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down the pogo rock move step by step, demonstrating it slowly before speeding it up. He encourages repetition and practice of the transition for better flow.

lesson_structure.note: Host introduces guest teacher Jay Rawk.
Teacher demonstrates the pogo rock slowly.
Teacher counts out the steps 1 through 4.
Teacher performs the pogo rock at a faster speed.
Teacher wraps up the lesson and offers encouragement.

metaphors: kind of uses it like as a spring

steps_taught.name: Pogo Rock
steps_taught.description: A transition back rock starting from the back and working up and down like a spring.

what_works: Slow demonstration followed by a counted breakdown
what_hinders: Lacks close-up angles of foot and hand placement

quotes.text: I call it the pogo rock.
Start from my back. Start one leg up.
Go one, two, three, in, come back to the same spot, four.
Take your time, step by step, so you guys can get the form.
